shortlist_policy: Keep at most three serious candidates for deeper inspection, but do not imply that shortlist membership means benchmark selection.

shortlisted_candidates.why_it_survives: Public raw serving measurements are joined to a public base-station table with coordinates, height, angle, tilt, frequency/channel fields, bandwidth, and numeric transmit-power field; building/DEM products are also present.
minimum_followups: Resolve raw ARFCN versus base downlink/frequency semantics with the authors or source code.
Establish whether antenna transmit power is conducted output, EIRP, or another reference-plane quantity.
Recover or document antenna gain/pattern and receiver height/calibration semantics.
Define the 342 unmapped raw serving rows and the NCI/ECI join policy.
Confirm aggregation, detection, and route/session semantics before any metric summary.

shortlisted_candidates.why_it_survives: Large public scanner/phone release has exact LTE B7/2.6 observations, serving identities, WGS84 trajectories, multiple measurement quantities, and building/terrain model context.
minimum_followups: Determine whether any authoritative transmitter configuration beyond inferred location/orientation can be released.
Keep inferred site/height/azimuth fields explicitly separate from measured truth.
Document receiver height, antenna chain, detection/censoring, and cross-device calibration semantics.
Define a deterministic NR NSA serving identity policy.
Use only selectively downloaded metadata or approved subarchives because the full release is large.
shortlisted_candidates.claim_class_if_followups_succeed: propagation_validation_candidate for LTE B7 and relative/quantity claims; not a full inventory candidate without transmitter RF fields

shortlisted_candidates.why_it_survives: Public measurement CSVs expose serving/detected RSRP/SINR and the README advertises base-station locations, antenna positions, azimuths, and mechanical/electrical tilt across altitude scenarios.
minimum_followups: Obtain the base-station configuration in a parseable, documented format.
Clarify local coordinate origin, axis convention, and the meaning of each z field.
Resolve dataset rights because no license file was identified.
Treat n79/4.9 GHz as a non-canonical quantity-validation contrast, not a 2.6/28 benchmark.
shortlisted_candidates.claim_class_if_followups_succeed: quantity_validation_only unless complete RF and coordinate provenance is supplied

not_shortlisted.reason: Restricted raw files trigger the access stop condition.
Public description states unavailable transmitter parameters were calibrated against measured RSRP; this is not independent uncalibrated truth.
Useful LTE measurement-only release but no matched transmitter inventory or complete RF configuration.
Useful cellular quantity records but no transmitter geometry/configuration and no exact canonical frequency pair.
Scenario/device measurements lack general transmitter inventory and clear rights metadata.
28 GHz CSI/channel traces are not cellular serving-cell measurements or inventory truth.

next_decision: Use the Chongqing record as a conditional future pilot only after metadata reconciliation; do not open 6B or implement an adapter from shortlist membership alone.
